text:
Situation: Hydroxocobalamin injection is in shortage at both Corvale East and Corvale General. Corvale East holds 20 vials of Actavis Pharma, Inc. product (NDC 00591288830, manufactured by Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A.) at 3.9 vials per day, providing 5.1 days of supply. Corvale General holds 75 vials of the same product at 4 vials per day, providing 18.7 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list includes hydroxocobalamin injection from BTG International Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., both listed as Current with initial posting on 2024-11-04. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 24 months.

Our position: Internal inventory is limited and unevenly distributed. The Actavis-labeled product we stock is not the same NDC as the BTG or Teva products on FDA's list. No alternative supply is currently qualified.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 vials of 1000 ug/mL, 30 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Xseer Pharmaceuticals — needs buyer approval; product is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no identifiable manufacturing plant.

Not recommended: No other sourcing or allocation changes at this time.
